name: The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria
author: GrassNotFound

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd
./steamcmd.sh +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update 3349480 validate +quit
